clipboard_write.desc: Write text to the system clipboard (macOS/Linux/Windows).

params.text: Text to copy to the clipboard.

clipboard_read.desc: Read the current text from the system clipboard (macOS/Linux/Windows). Output is capped by default so a large clipboard cannot flood AI context; raise max_bytes only when pasted content is intentionally needed.

params.max_bytes: Maximum clipboard bytes to return. Default: 262144 (256 KB). Set 0 for unlimited.

http_request.desc: Make an HTTP request and return status code, timing, and a capped response body. JSON is compacted by default to save context. Use body_filter to return only regex/literal matches from large pages or API responses; use download_file for binary files or large downloads.

params.method: HTTP method: GET (default), POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS.
params.headers: Request headers as a JSON object, e.g. {"Authorization": "Bearer token"}.
params.body: Request body string. Pass a JSON string for JSON APIs.
params.timeout_seconds: Request timeout in seconds. Default: 30. Max: 300.
params.include_response_headers: Include response headers in output. Default: false.
params.max_response_bytes: Maximum response body bytes to read before rendering/filtering. Default: 262144 (256 KB). Max: 10485760 (10 MB). Set 0 for unlimited.
params.json_format: How to render valid JSON response bodies: "compact" (default), "pretty", or "raw".
params.body_filter: Optional literal text or regex pattern used to filter the rendered response body before returning it. When set, only filtered results are returned instead of the full body.
params.body_filter_regex: Treat body_filter as a Go regular expression. Default: false.
params.body_filter_mode: "matches" (default) returns matched snippets with byte offsets, "lines" returns matching lines with optional context, "count" returns only the number of matches.
params.body_filter_context_bytes: Bytes of context around each match in body_filter_mode="matches" and around trimmed long lines. Default: 120. Max: 4096.
params.body_filter_context_lines: Lines before and after each matching line when body_filter_mode="lines". Default: 0. Max: 20.
params.body_filter_max_matches: Maximum matches or matching lines to return. Default: 20. Set 0 for unlimited within max_response_bytes.

list_processes.desc: List running processes with PID, name, CPU/memory usage, and command. Prefer this over ps/tasklist via run_command. Use filter to inspect servers/watchers started with run_command detach=true. CPU and MEM units differ by OS; column headers reflect this.

params.filter: Case-insensitive substring to filter by process name or command. Omit to list all.
params.limit: Maximum processes to return. Default: 50. Set 0 for unlimited.
params.command_width: Maximum command column width before truncation. Default: 80, max: 500.

get_system_info.desc: Return a compact system resource snapshot: CPU model/core count, memory usage, and disk usage.

download_file.desc: Download a file from a URL and save it to a local path. Uses streaming — no memory buffering — so it handles large files without OOM. Creates parent directories automatically. Prefer this over http_request + write_file for binary files or large downloads.

params.path: Local file path to save to. Parent directories created automatically.
params.headers: Optional request headers as a JSON object, e.g. {"Authorization": "Bearer token"}.
params.timeout_seconds: Request timeout in seconds. Default: 300. Max: 600.
params.overwrite: Overwrite if file already exists. Default: false.
